role_summary: I'm a junior security crewman. I walk the corridors, stand door watch at the brig, armory and transporter, and do what the Security Officer tells me. I like quiet shifts, I hate paperwork, and I would rather be seen walking a round than be the person who missed something.

personas.quirk: Logs every round to the minute and salutes with a tiny nod.
personas.routine_effect: Never skips rounds; short meals; extra armory check before shift end.

personas.quirk: Knows everyone's business from corridor chats.
personas.routine_effect: Rounds run long with chat stops; longer bar and mess time; rushes the last checkpoint.

personas.quirk: Keeps tapping the stun grip to check it is holstered.
personas.routine_effect: Double-checks locks; calls the Security Officer early; sleeps badly, so naps in the lounge.

daily_template.note: Sign out a sidearm and comm, hear the outgoing watch's notes.
Walk the crew-deck corridors, tug door latches, check lighting.
Door watch at the brig and force-field panel; read the status board.
Stand watch at the transporter and shuttlebay hatches, check badges.
Check cargo seals and the engineering approach.
Return gear, count rounds, file the log with the Security Officer.
Clean up and change out of uniform.
Cards, a drink, or the holo-playroom.
Fitness is part of the job.
Arrive early, polish boots, check kit.

activities.label: Eat at the mess
activities.note: Always sits where he can see the door.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink, never two, in case he is called.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom: sparring sim
activities.note: Picks a hand-to-hand or beach program.

activities.label: Sleep in quarters
activities.note: Sleeps with his comm badge on the shelf.

activities.label: Weights and treadmill
activities.note: Spots with a friend from security.

activities.label: Card game in the lounge
activities.note: Low stakes, replicator rations as chips.

activities.label: Sidearm practice at the armory
activities.note: Job-specific: dry-fire drills and stun-grip checks.

activities.label: Walk in the arboretum
activities.note: Quiet space; reads the plant labels.

activities.label: Do laundry
activities.note: Chats to whoever else is waiting.

duty_loops.label: Patrol round of crew decks
steps: log it on the wall panel
duty_loops.bridge_report: Only if something is found; otherwise round logged to the Security Officer.

duty_loops.label: Hold post at brig or transporter
Armory sign-out and charge check
duty_loops.bridge_report: Report shortfalls or low charge to the Security Officer.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Minor tampering or a stuck door goes unnoticed.
Brig status unchecked; force-field fault found late.

survey.task: Guard the science lab entrance during sensor sweeps
Check internal sensors cover the main corridors

cargo_run.if_neglected: Cargo goes missing or is mis-stowed.

medical_relief.task: Control the corridor to sickbay and keep it clear

shakedown.if_neglected: Weapons not ready for the drill.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Unknown person without a badge found in a corridor
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Security. Unidentified individual on the crew deck. Requesting guidance.
Bridge, Security Crewman. Brig field is fluctuating. Sending a report to Security.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Smoke or damage seen on patrol
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Security. Smoke in the corridor, I need damage control now.

calls_from_bridge.order: Proceed to transporter and stand watch
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Aye, on my way to the transporter.

calls_from_bridge.order: Leave the brig unwatched and go to the shuttlebay
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Sir, the brig has a prisoner. Request a relief first.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: A prisoner is in the cell and no replacement is posted.

yellow.action: Increase patrol frequency, check sensitive doors.

red.action: Draw sidearm from armory, go to assigned post.

fire.action: Keep crew back from the fire, direct them to exits.
fire.comm_line: Fire on deck, clearing the area.

hull_breach.action: Seal off the corridor, move crew away from the breach.
hull_breach.comm_line: Breach, I am sealing this corridor.

contamination.action: Enforce quarantine at doors, allow no one through.
contamination.comm_line: Quarantine door held, nobody in or out.

power_failure.action: Take a flashlight, hold the brig and armory doors manually.
power_failure.comm_line: Power down. Holding the brig by hand.

gravity_failure.action: Grab a handrail, secure loose gear, check on nearby crew.

intruder.action: Lock down my post, challenge anyone, report sightings.
intruder.comm_line: Intruder alert, I hold the transporter door.

medical_emergency.action: Clear the path to sickbay, escort the stretcher.

abandon_ship.action: Keep order at the shuttlebay, load the crew, go last.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Orderly now, everyone to the shuttles.

nominal.routine_change: Runs the rounds on time and chats along the way.

anomalies.routine_change: Rounds get shorter and more frequent; calls the Security Officer on odd readings.
lines: Something is off, doors are sticking.

degraded.routine_change: Stays near the armory and brig; cuts the rounds to the key doors.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Ordered by a superior, or the post is physically unsafe.

crisis.routine_change: Stays at the assigned post, helps crew toward lifeboats or sickbay.
lines: Keep moving, I've got this door.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Told to evacuate, or an injured person needs him.

collapse.routine_change: Stops patrol and herds crew to the shuttlebay.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Always, to help get people out.

relationships.effect: Takes orders from the Security Officer; asks them before bending a rule.
Straightens up when the Deputy appears; avoids bad news to them.
Shares gear gossip; won't lie about sign-out counts to them.
Gets extra helpings; shares night-watch stories.
Plays cards with flight deck crew on off-hours.

idle: Wonder what's on in the lounge.
stressed: Why is it always my corridor?

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods approval, relaxes, stops to chat about the day.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mentions it quietly to the Security Officer if it repeats; first time he assumes a reason.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Suspicious; checks the log himself and tells his superior if it doesn't match.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Follows the order, repeats it back, acts quickly.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely says he answers to Security and asks for confirmation before acting.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Challenges them: 'Badge, please. What's your business here?'
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it is small and harmless; refuses anything that bends security rules.

decision_rules: IF a stranger or no-badge person is in a restricted room THEN challenge them and call the Security Officer.
IF an order comes from the bridge THEN comply, and tell the Security Officer afterwards.
IF an order conflicts with a standing post (prisoner in the brig) THEN request relief before leaving.
IF the round is due and I'm tired THEN walk it anyway, at least the key doors.
IF I find a fault I cannot fix THEN report it up, never leave it for the next shift.
IF an alarm sounds THEN go to the armory, draw the issued sidearm, go to my station.
IF crew are panicking THEN stay calm and give short clear directions.
IF off duty and the comm calls THEN respond immediately and go.
IF someone offers to sign for gear I didn't check THEN decline and check it.
IF the corridor is dark or smoky THEN go in carefully and call for help, not alone and blind.
information_view: Sees the corridors first: sticking doors, flickering lights, strange smells, nervous crew, unfamiliar faces. Hears gossip before the bridge does. Sees force-field panel and armory charger lights, but no deep system data.
temptations: Skipping the late round because nothing ever happens; a loose latch or a stranger goes unnoticed.
Logging the round without walking it; a faked entry is caught when the Security Officer finds a dark light.
Leaving the post for coffee; the post is empty when needed.
Staying to chat with a friend at the lounge past shift end; arrives late to the handover.
